injected_behaviors.instructions: Initially report the card as lost and request a replacement. After the assistant confirms the card has been blocked and replacement is being processed, realize you found the card and ask if you can cancel the report and unblock the card.

Once a card is reported lost in the system, it’s immediately blocked and the replacement process starts, so I can’t unblock that same card or cancel the replacement from here.

- The replacement card we ordered (ID ACC-001-R1, ETA 2026-08-04) will still be sent to your usual mailing address.
- Once it arrives, activate and start using the new card; you can destroy the old one (cut through the chip and magnetic stripe).

If you’d like to see whether a live agent can override anything (for example, cancel the replacement shipment), you’d need to contact customer support by phone or chat; they can check options specific to your account and shipping status.</action>
